observed_failure.confirmed: bootstrap_schema rejected runtime schema/table DDL before activation. Actions compensation evidence belongs to the existing release coordinator.

regression.baseline_result: On unchanged production base: 1 passed (empty), 2 failed (owned/direct_create), exit 1. Both failures are the exact Projection runtime must not hold schema/table DDL authority guard.
regression.repair: Explicit sealed-bootstrap opt-in transfers only directly runtime-owned known projection objects to the separate migration identity and revokes direct schema CREATE/table TRIGGER. Final DDL guard remains, including default/inherited TRIGGER grants.
regression.positive_layouts: Empty, runtime-owned schema/tables, database+schema+tables ownership, tables-only ownership, direct CREATE, direct TRIGGER; actual init-db.sh and resolved Compose pantheon_app identity; production bootstrap shell and CLI, local transport substitution only.
regression.durability: Seeded actual lifecycle receipts, journeys, identities and live controller/checkpoint; compared all seven table readbacks before/after upgrade and two repeats; fresh projector resumed to checkpoint 8. Runtime CREATE/ALTER/DROP TABLE and DROP SCHEMA denied; public data/DDL authority preserved.
regression.negatives: PUBLIC/inherited CREATE, inherited admin/TRIGGER, unknown relation, wrong schema/table owner, custom routine, wrong schema/database/runtime authority, insufficient migration authority, default TRIGGER privileges. Catalog ownership/ACLs and all rows unchanged on refusal; actual post-transfer SQL and GRANT failures both roll back.

postgres.isolation: Task-owned disposable container, random loopback port 32810; per-test disposable databases; fixed isolated-test credential is test-only.
postgres.recreate: docker run --name <task-local-name> -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=isolated-test -e POSTGRES_DB=pantheon -p 127.0.0.1::5432 -d postgres:16-alpine; use docker port to set the test DSNs and TEST_PROJECTION_CONTAINER. Remove only that test container after validation.
